mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust aggregate demand, generating positive equity returns over 60 trading days through earnings acceleration.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a cooling inflation trend below 2.5% signals reduced central bank urgency, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and CPIAUCSL < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (index) indicates sustained manufacturing output growth, supporting corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 150,000 jobs signals robust labor market strength, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS increase > 150k.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates accelerating consumer and housing demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate rise above 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.
